name: Search API generic devel
description: Provides Devel information for indexed entities.
project_description:
The Search API Generic Devel module provides a new tab in the entity devel tab group.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 
 The indexed data.
 
 Fields indexed. 
 Extra data (server dependent). 
 Query time. 
 
 
 Locally generated data (data to be indexed on next reindex). 
 Reindex (or index) an entity manually. 
 Delete an entity index item. 
 
 Back to top 

 Similar modules 
 The Search API devel module is very similar to this, but it only has a D7 version. I created this module because I missed a devel tool for the database server option, which felt to much like a black box, when creating new indices.
